target_customer: Startups and brands that run paid ads on Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter
problem: Running paid ads well needs strategy, creative production and constant optimization that small teams lack or pay agencies heavily for.
business_model: Subscription per brand per month (listed at 990 USD, or 490 USD annual prepay) plus a managed service from 2,500 USD per month or 10 percent of ad spend
product_category: AI agents for paid advertising management

founders.name: Robin Choy
previous_startups: Botdog (co-founded, sold to Scale Shift Ventures, February 2026)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; education not listed. Also runs an angel fund per YC page.

founders.name: Guillaume Miara
education: UC Berkeley and CentraleSupelec, Master's in Operations Research
previous_startups: Botdog (co-founded, sold to Scale Shift Ventures, February 2026)

competitors.name: Madgicx
competitors.what: Agentic AI advertising platform for Meta ads with an AI Marketer for audits and one click actions

competitors.name: Pencil
competitors.what: AI ad creative generator, does not launch or manage campaigns

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly orchestration of LLMs over ad platform APIs and creative generation; hard parts are reliable optimization and platform API access.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded competitors offer similar agents and Meta and Google ship native AI (Advantage+, Performance Max); the offering is easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platforms and well funded startups were already building the same wedge in 2026; no outcome yet.

market_need_then: The founders say they wished for this service at their previous B2B marketing company; pricing on the site and a claim of 30 live companies (company claim) suggest early demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses adside.ai, an AI domain rather than .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, founder led; charges 50 USD per demo as a qualifier (company claim)

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; name resembles Aside and other ad tech names.

outcome_analysis: Adside is a Fall 2026 YC company from founders who sold Botdog in February 2026 and used their own ad needs as the starting point. The market is crowded with funded agentic ad tools and native platform AI, so the outcome depends on execution and distribution; no result is known yet.
notes: Dealroom lists an undated 125K USD seed round for Adside; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. Slashdot lists different pricing than the company site. Location conflicts (San Francisco vs Paris in aggregators). Botdog sale: seven figures, press release dated 17 February 2026. Competitor source dates are approximate.
